claim: Bounded public DESI DR1 strong-lensing VAC positional overlap and kinematic-data availability; not confirmation of lensing or dynamical theory
screen_caveat: Quality cuts are transparent preliminary heuristics, not complete DESI validation. Spectrum may sample source or neighbour, not lens. Redshift-photometric consistency flag is diagnostic only.
negative_result_scope: Absence only from this2176rowVAC, not all DESI/SDSS/other spectroscopy
deduplication: Retain observation rows and count unique TARGETID separately; no multiple-counting of visits as independent lenses.
